shortDescription: Set and/or get members' attributes of an Apache httpd 2.4 mod_proxy balancer pool

options.name: balancer_url_suffix
options.description: Suffix of the balancer pool URL required to access the balancer pool status page (for example V(balancer_vhost[:port]/balancer_url_suffix)).

options.name: balancer_vhost
options.description: (IPv4|IPv6|FQDN):port of the Apache httpd 2.4 mod_proxy balancer pool.

options.name: member_host
options.description: (IPv4|IPv6|FQDN) of the balancer member to get or to set attributes to. Port number is autodetected and should not be specified here. If undefined, the M(community.general.apache2_mod_proxy) module returns a members list of dictionaries of all the current balancer pool members' attributes.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the member host. States can be simultaneously invoked by separating them with a comma (for example V(state=drained,ignore_errors)), but it is recommended to specify them as a proper YAML list. States V(present) and V(absent) must be used without any other state.

options.name: tls
options.description: Use https to access balancer management page.
